affected_existing_tasks.description: Every existing task contract this change leaves asserting something a governing document no longer says. An empty array is a claim the independent review tests; it is not the default for an omission.

reason.description: The stale statement, the document that now contradicts it, and why a reader would be misled.

resolved_task_impacts.description: Task IDs whose open conflict, raised by an earlier amendment, this change repairs. A resolution only clears a raise from a strictly earlier amendment.
